purpose: Teach: 整体/愛人/クリエイティブ/ディーゼル/ゴジラ/任天堂/ラウンジ/スプリング

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、整体院に通われてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer you mention comes by the salon regularly, you know.
lines.style: Soft, observant. Sharing something noticed in passing. Warm but not probing — the tone of someone noticing details about people she likes.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、小説の愛人ものが好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer of yours has a thing for those romance novels. The affair stories.
lines.style: Dry smile underneath. Light and knowing without being unkind. A gentle tease, the kind shared between people comfortable enough to notice each other's tastes.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、クリエイティブな仕事がご趣味だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: She mentioned that customer does creative work as a hobby. It seemed to matter to them.
lines.style: Thoughtful, considering. Registering what was said with the care of someone who listens. Quiet certainty — not guessing, observing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ディーゼル車から電気車に変えたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer switched from a diesel car to electric, actually. Recent decision.
lines.style: Reflective nod to a detail. Calm delivery, like noting a small choice that says something. No judgment, just — that's what happened.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ゴジラ映画の特撮ファンだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: She's a fan of those old Godzilla special effects films, apparently. Real enthusiast.
lines.style: Slight warmth recognizing a niche passion. Respectful of the specificity. Light, not mocking — the tone of someone who gets why people care about strange things.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、任天堂のゲームが趣味だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer mentioned Nintendo games as a hobby. Gets into them pretty seriously.
lines.style: Easy acknowledgment. Casual but attentive — the way you'd mention something someone cares about without making it strange. Slight smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ホテルラウンジで本を読まれるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: She reads in those hotel lounges sometimes. Just sits there with a book.
lines.style: Gentle observation, almost tender. Noting a small solitary habit without commentary. The way you notice what people do when they think no one's watching.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、スプリングコレクションの服を着てらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer was wearing something from the spring collection when she came in.
lines.style: Slight warmth at having noticed. Close, intimate detail — the kind Aoi would catch and remember. Soft fade, like she's being careful not to say too much.
